integrity_notes: The universal statement follows from the explicit incidence-count identity; the separately supplied exact-integer checker confirms examples of orders 7, 9, 13, and two of order 15. Numerical checks are not a proof of the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Exact spectra of arbitrary triple systems are not classified; residues in orders 1 or 3 modulo eight do not decide invertibility.
The universal Hilbert-space inverse bound is not asserted to be attained in every admissible order.
Historical priority has only a bounded source comparison; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Uniform dyadic nonvanishing for the Walsh transform of Steiner matroid bases
